title: Empowering cloud network operation with self-intelligence through the network large model toolchain platform
summary: China Telecom describes an internal pilot of its network large model toolchain platform, which is meant to streamline cloud network operations and collaborative development.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: China Telecom describes a toolchain that combines the processing of telecom data, knowledge management, model training, and agent deployment. The company reports an internal pilot and plans wider use. Its target for 2025 was a platform that could support concurrent use by 30 percent of users across the entire network. China Telecom gives no comparison of time, cost, or service quality that the pilot achieved. ITU republished the same text in its final report of October 2025. No later source reports whether China Telecom met the target.
purpose: Streamline telecom model development and intelligent-agent operations.
